 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**The misspelled word is 'tendancy'.** 

__
 
• **The correct spelling would be 'tendency'. **
 
• The word '**tendency**' is a **noun** which means 'an inclination toward a particular characteristic or type of behaviour, or a belief or point of view'. **(प्रवृत्ति)** 
 
 
• **For Example -** 
 
• He has a tendency to exaggerate. 
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer would be** 'tendancy'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Let's understand the meanings of the other options that are correctly spelled - ** 

 
• **Resistance -** the refusal to accept or comply with something; the ability not to be affected by something. **(प्रतिरोध) **
 
• **Separate -** form, constitute, or be a part or portion of something; be distinguished from something else. **(अलग) **
 
• **Weather -** the state of the atmosphere at a particular place and time as regards heat, cloudiness, dryness, sunshine, wind, rain, etc. **(मौसम)**
